status: predictions fixed before unequal-virtuality amplitude extraction
scheme: VVamp class A massless quarks; qT finite remainder; mu2=s; alpha_s/(2*pi) per loop
assumption: Same r1=r2=0 two-loop kernel boundary as the current Letter; this is what the extension tests, not a separately established unequal-virtuality theorem.
normalization: c1 is the independently extracted one-loop coefficient of G for the same helicity
fit_plan: Unconstrained complex polynomial in G through degree 3, plus pT2/sqrt(ma2*mb2) times polynomial through degree P; compare P=0,1,2,3, sliding windows and overdetermined fits. One-loop degree 1 plus power corrections through degree 2. No predicted coefficients are fixed in fits.
out_of_scope: changes to main or publication manuscripts
